issues.quote: Cash and cash equivalents ended fiscal 2025 at $86.8 million, compared with $78.8 billion in fiscal 2024.
issues.problem: Unit error: the figure should be $86.8 billion, not million. As written, cash would have fallen by about 99.9%.

data.summary: The figures are mostly consistent. Revenue growth of 12.4% checks out. Net income growth of 31.1% is within rounding (the rounded figures give about 31.3%). Cash for fiscal 2025 is wrongly given as $86.8 million instead of $86.8 billion.
